title: Xero payments
steps: Open Invoices, then Sent.
Hover the paid Xero link.
Open the invoice and its Linked card.

title: Jobs with no invoice
steps: Open the job with no invoice.
Link the best matching invoice.
Open the invoice to confirm its job link.

title: Create Xero clients
steps: Open the pending invoice.
Create the missing Xero client and confirm.
The problem clears and the invoice is Ready.

title: Job board stages
steps: Open Jobs on the board, grouped by Status.
Open a job to see its client, work stage and mapped price code.
Close the job, switch to List, then return to Board.

title: Group, sort and filter
steps: Group jobs by Client.
Add a sort by Due, oldest first.
Filter Status to Shipped. Seven of 42 jobs remain.

title: Reconcile finds the gaps
steps: Open the job with no invoice and inspect the best matching draft.
Press Link this invoice. Reconcile moves to the next gap.
Open the SYNTHETIC-GAP invoice on Ready. Its Linked card shows the job.

title: Own price list
steps: Open the CR-ZR price code, then cancel.
Change its price before tax from $160.00 to $175.00 and save.
Open the code again to see the saved price, then return to the list.

title: Custom fields on jobs
steps: Open case 48200 on the Jobs board.
Set Rush, choose shade B1, and set Scan received.
Close and open the job again. All three custom field values remain in Flow.

title: Invoice rules: save an age check
steps: Open the Old job rule, then cancel.
Change its age check from more than 90 days to more than 60 days and save.
Open the rule again. It keeps 60 days and Wait for a person.
limits: Shows a saved rule edit, not ready-stage changes or an automation run.

title: Invoice tabs (now seven)
steps: Start on Ready, then open Pending to see the No lines problem.
Open Draft, Approved, Sent, Non-chargeable and Void.
Return to Ready. The current product adds Non-chargeable to the six original tabs.
limits: Draft, Sent, Non-chargeable and Void are empty in this seed.
No Accept change, recheck, Seazona order link or Xero state change is shown.
